description: Read compact project and editor state for references such as 'this node', 'the selected node', and 'place it here'. Returns only available project/build, perform mode, pane, active Network Editor, current/selected, rollover and viewport fields; unavailable UI fields are omitted with warnings instead of inferred. Does not dump project topology or mutate TouchDesigner.
name: get_editor_context
title: Get TouchDesigner editor context
